response.overview: By using an intervalometer and positioning the shutter to remain open between frames, I was able to capture the mystery of what happens during sleep, using dim streetlight and the anticipated glow of the rising sun.  This film has been screened at the Andy Warhol Museum, Three Rivers Arts Festival, Pittsburgh Filmmakers, The Pulitzer Foundation for the Arts, and was made possible by a grant from Pittsburgh Filmmakers
response.title: Sleep Film
